sentence: His mother took him to different places for therapy every week.
synonym: brought him to various locations for treatment
synonymNote: 两者都表示带某人去多个地方接受治疗，意思相同。

distractors.word: left him at home to rest
distractors.note: 意思相反，是让他待在家里，不是带他外出。

distractors.word: took him to one place for fun
distractors.note: 是去一个地方娱乐，不是多个地方治疗。

distractors.word: sent him away for a holiday
distractors.note: 是送他去度假，不是带他接受治疗。
